licences.notes: Words as printed in the Schirmer vocal score. Kept as printed: Elvira's "Mille, mille" (bar 54) and Zerlina's lower-case "mille" (bar 56); "novità" printed without its accent once for Elvira (bar 105) and once for Zerlina (bar 54), so the word is written "novita" there.

licences.source: G. Schirmer vocal score, New York 1900 (plate 15147, IMSLP #68957), pages 200–212, bars 1–147 of the Molto allegro of No. 19
licences.author: G. Schirmer, piano reduction as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages in three chunks (pp. 200–203, 204–207, 208–212): the sung lines and the piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar and checked again by fresh checkers, whose findings were corrected. Don Ottavio's part, printed in the treble clef, is written at sounding pitch. Kept as printed: Masetto's D natural in bar 93 against D-flat in the other voices, and the piano's B-flat/D chord in the right hand of bar 23. The English singing translation and the stage directions are left out. The piece continues "Sola, sola in bujo loco", the sextet's Andante, a separate piece. Playback tempo: ♩ = 245 (𝅗𝅥 ≈ 122), about 2½ minutes, the median (2:24) of five recordings that put the Molto allegro on its own track (Haitink 1984 2:17, Keilberth 1962 2:22, Busch 1936 2:24, Norrington 2:35, I. Fischer 2:46); Mozart gives the words Molto allegro only.
